title: Revealing the Semantic Selection Gap in DINOv3 through Training-Free Few-Shot Segmentation (FSSDINO)
mechanism: Training-free FSS with frozen DINOv3: class prototypes plus Gram-matrix refinement; last layer is a strong default, best intermediate layer is better but hard to select.
evidence: R: competitive with specialised FSS methods on binary, multi-class and cross-domain FSS benchmarks.
adaptation: Cheapest K-shot benchmark baseline and a layer-wise diagnostic of which DINOv3/DINOv2 layer separates EL classes; DINOv3 gated, DINOv2 fallback.
min_experiment: K-shot track row and G0 entry vs house PF fine-tuned on the same K cells; inactive IoU on H36; kill as labeller if below SAM2 video mode.
prior_overlap: Partial: frozen DINOv3/DINOv2 linear probes showed no gain over ResNet-34 in-distribution; prototype few-shot use on new contexts not tested.
